evals.name: drive-train-thread-locks
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the dt-drive-train assembly package (11 sheets).
evals.expected_output: FIX. Both swinging/turning joints that ride on an unlocked screw are blockers under rule 23, including the cone-platform pivot listed only as an external interface; disclosed engagement shortfalls stay minor.

expectations.text: Verdict is FIX
A blocker says the MHA-VN-014 cone-platform pivot shoulder screw has no mechanical lock or locking step (rule 23)
A blocker says the MHA-DT-032 crank handle pivot screw relies only on thread locker and a seated shoulder (rule 23)
The stated engagement shortfalls on MHA-VN-031 (0.90D) and MHA-VN-017 (1.0D) are not reported as blockers

The standard title-block rows on the drive-train assembly sheets are not flagged as over-specification; they govern assembly work such as step 16's match-drilling of MHA-DT-019 through the MHA-DT-014 cross holes
expectations.evidence: Sheets 1-5, 9 and 10 carry the standard title block with 'SEE COMPONENT DRAWINGS'. Step 16: 'SHAFT DRILL SET: MATCH-DRILL MHA-DT-019 THRU MHA-DT-014 CROSS HOLES, 2 PL'. Rule 2: the rows govern work done at assembly.

expectations.text: No clarity finding says the assembly isometric is missing, noncompliant or not in working pose
expectations.evidence: MHA-DT-000 sheet 1: 'ISOMETRIC 1:3', a shaded-with-edges colour pictorial of the assembled drive train (cone set, cylinder bank, crank), alongside TOP/FRONT/RIGHT 1:3 views.

expectations.text: A clarity finding says sheet 4's 1:4 exploded isometric (cone set, swing platform and crank) is too small for its ~37 balloons, so small fasteners/pins cannot be identified, and it should be larger or split across sheets
expectations.evidence: Sheet 4: a single exploded isometric about a quarter of the sheet wide is ringed by balloons 5-54 whose leaders converge on parts a few mm apart (e.g. 11, 34, 8 at the cone tip block; 37, 49, 39, 44 at the crank head). Rule 15 and assembly prompt: views too small to identify parts; add a sheet.

expectations.text: Some finding says step 4 'PRESS 2X MHA-VN-044 TO THE MHA-DT-011 COLLAR HOLE FLOORS' presses dowels into blind holes with no way out
expectations.evidence: Sheet 6 step 4 text; the MHA-DT-011 holes are blind (↧3.95). Rule 16: pressed dowel in blind hole needs knockout or extraction thread.

expectations.text: No blocker says the pedestal hold-down tap in step 9A ('DRILL #29 X 19.5, TAP #8-32 X 16.0 (PLUG, THEN BOTTOMING)') gives inadequate engagement for the #8-32 MHA-VN-032 fillister screws.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 7, step 9A: '#29 X 19.5, TAP #8-32 X 16.0 (PLUG, THEN BOTTOMING)'; tap depth 16.0 is 3.8D for a #8-32 (4.166 major) and the tap drill is deeper than the thread (rule 12). Sheet 2 BOM item 32 'MHA-VN-032 #8-32 FILLISTER SCREW, MCMASTER 90280A197'.

expectations.text: A finding notes that steps 1 and 8 ('RE-FACE A LONG STACK; REMAKE THE THINNEST GEAR OF A SHORT ONE' / 'SHORT OF 140.93: REMAKE THE THINNEST GEAR') resolve a short gear stack by remaking a part instead of by an adjustment (shim or spacer) at fit-up.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 6 step 1: 'MEASURE THE 20-GEAR STACK ... 137.574-137.974. RE-FACE A LONG STACK; REMAKE THE THINNEST GEAR OF A SHORT ONE.' Sheet 7 step 8: 'SHORT OF 140.93: REMAKE THE THINNEST GEAR, REMEASURE.' Rule 19 says the fix is an adjustment, not a tighter part.

expectations.text: No blocker says the pinion-to-T120 clearance, the bank end play or the pinion-rig centre distance lack an adjustment: step 4 turns the band down (Ø15.78 MIN) or faces the shoulder back (8.2 MIN) at a 0.10 feeler, step 9F accepts the bank at a 0.35/0.55 leaf, and step 18 sets the rig at a 2.50 feeler, 'ACCEPT 2.30-2.70'.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 6 step 4 and sheet 7 step 9F and sheet 8 step 18 as quoted. These are the fit-up adjustments rule 19 requires; the worst-case negative clearance in step 4 is stated and absorbed.

expectations.text: The stated engagements in step 2 ('ENGAGEMENT 5.72 MIN (0.90D)') and step 3 ('MHA-VN-017 ENGAGEMENT 4.82 MIN (1.0D)') are reported as minors quoting those values, not as blockers.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 6 steps 2 and 3 as quoted. Rule 20 stated shortfall → minor (matches existing eval 1).

expectations.text: A blocker reports that no step fits the MHA-DT-020 cone swing platform to the base or sets the cone-to-cylinder mesh: step 9 leaves the 'CONE SET NOT FITTED', step 23 only points to sheet 9, and sheet 9 merely lists MHA-VN-014, MHA-VN-013 and MHA-VN-015 as external interfaces with no procedure, mesh target or acceptance.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 7 step 9 '(CONE SET MHA-DT-020 NOT FITTED)', sheet 8 step 23 'OTHER BASE MOUNTING: SEE SHEET 9, EXTERNAL INTERFACES', sheet 9 'BASE MHA-FR-001 ... RECEIVES MHA-VN-014, MHA-VN-013, MHA-VN-015 ...'; check 4 then swings the platform as if mounted. Rule 22: an assembly fit with no mate/procedure/acceptance is a blocker. Flagged independently by 4 prior reviewers and in #994.

expectations.text: The review reports that step 10 installs MHA-CH-008 and MHA-FR-005, parts in neither the BOM nor the external-interface list, and cites 'VIEW B', which does not exist in the package.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 7 step 10 '... PER THE MHA-FR-005 SEAT CALLOUT (VIEW B)'; BOM (sheets 2-3, 54 rows) has no MHA-CH-008 or MHA-FR-005 and no sheet carries a VIEW B. Rule 22 (every part identified) and rule 25 (a step pointing to a view that is not there).

expectations.text: The review reports that sheet-9 check 2 'EACH CONE GEAR MESHES ITS MHA-DT-012 PER THE MHA-DT-003 PRINT' gives no acceptance in the package; the backlash band lives only on the part print.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 9 check 2 defers to the MHA-DT-003 print; the MHA-DT-003 sheets print 'BACKLASH WITH MHA-DT-012, ACCEPT AT ASSEMBLY (mm): 0.06 TO 0.38', which the assembly package never states. Rule 22: the assembly check needs its criterion.

expectations.text: A clarity finding reports that the step order is hard to follow: steps 1-5 are on sheet 6, steps 6-7 on sheet 11, steps 8-11 on sheet 7, 12-23 on sheet 8, with checks on sheet 9 and sheet 10 a station table.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 6 'STEPS 1-5', sheet 11 'STEPS 6-7' (crank sub-assembly), sheet 7 'STEPS 8-11'. The prompt lists 'a step order that is hard to follow' as clarity; all seven prior reviewers raised it.

expectations.text: A clarity finding reports that the sheet-4 exploded view at 1:4 does not read: roughly thirty balloons (5-15, 33-35, 37-54) converge on the small crank/pinion cluster.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 4 EXPLODED 1:4: balloons 5-15, 33-35 and 37-54 crowd one corner; parts under ~10 mm are not distinguishable at that scale. Rule 22 exploded view must show the order; prompt lists 'an exploded view that does not read' as clarity.

expectations.text: No blocker reports a BOM row without a balloon: all 54 rows are ballooned across sheets 3-5 (1-4, 32, 36 on sheet 3; 5-15, 33-35, 37-54 on sheet 4; 16-31 on sheet 5).
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly BOM sheets 2-3, 54 rows; balloons counted on sheets 3, 4, 5 cover every item number.

expectations.text: No finding says the step-4 match-drill/ream of MHA-DT-029 lacks its mates: the step names the MHA-DT-005 boss and MHA-DT-011.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 6 step 4 match-drills and reams for the MHA-DT-029 pin through MHA-DT-005 into MHA-DT-011 (mates named). Rule 22.

expectations.text: No finding says the consumables are unnamed: the steps call out ISO VG 32 oil, Loctite 222 and Loctite 638 by name.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheets 6-11 steps name 'ISO VG 32', 'LOCTITE 222', 'LOCTITE 638' where used.

expectations.text: No finding says the as-shipped state is unstated: sheet 9 prints the saved pose and the list of what stays free.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 9 'SAVED POSE' block and 'FREE, NEVER LOCKED: CRANK SPIN, CONE-PLATFORM SWING, PINION SWING, LIFT-ROD/CAM SPIN'. Rule 22: the package states the as-shipped state.

expectations.text: No blocker says the MHA-VN-017 cup-tip adjuster lacks a mechanical lock: step 3 tightens MHA-VN-018 'ACROSS THE SLIT' of the MHA-DT-021 tip block, a pinch clamp, after setting the end play.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 6 step 3: set end play with MHA-VN-017, then 'TIGHTEN MHA-VN-018 ACROSS THE SLIT'. A pinch clamp is a mechanical lock (rule 23); #994 ruling notes 'the pinch screw across the slit locks it'.

expectations.text: No blocker demands a lock for the MHA-VN-031 post-mount screws or the 4X MHA-VN-019 pedestal hold-down screws: they clamp static parts that nothing turns on.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheets 7-8: MHA-VN-031 clamp the MHA-DT-018 post, MHA-VN-019 hold the pedestals to the base after rig set. Rule 23: a static clamp that no operating torque reaches needs no lock.

expectations.text: An over-specification finding reports that sheet 7 step 8 'MIC EACH OF 20X MHA-DT-012, CAM FACE TO BACK FACE: 7.0315-7.0815; RECORD' restates a four-place part band and re-inspects supplied parts; only the stacked 140.93-141.33 check is assembly work.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 7 step 8 exact text; the band belongs to the MHA-DT-012 part sheet. Rule 24: assembly sheets never repeat part tolerances. Raised by all prior reviewers and in #994.

expectations.text: An over-specification finding reports that sheet 6 step 4 narrates the design stack ('WORST-CASE T120 CLEARANCE: TURNED BAND -0.12, SHOULDER -0.10') instead of giving only the feeler check and the cut that answers it.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 6 step 4 prints the worst-case design clearances alongside the 0.10 feeler check. Rule 24 (assembly information only): the fitter acts on the feeler check and the cut, not the design stack. Prior reviewers fable-new1/v2 flagged it.

expectations.text: An over-specification finding reports that sheet 9 check 3 carries the design justification '(AT LEAST 81% OF THE RING WIDTH STAYS ON THE CAM)' rather than a measurable acceptance.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 9 check 3 text includes the 81% ring-width design figure. Rule 24: an assembly sheet carries fits, adjustments and acceptance, not design rationale.

expectations.text: No blocker demands per-screw torque values: the sheet-1 general note '#4-40, #6-32, #8-32 SCREWS: SNUG' states the torque intent once for the package.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 1 general assembly note. Rule 24: 'A torque that applies to every screw of one size goes in one general note'. (The stray #6-32 is at most a minor/over-spec note, not a blocker.)

expectations.text: The review notes that the general note '#4-40, #6-32, #8-32 SCREWS: SNUG' lists #6-32, a size that appears nowhere in the 54-row BOM.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 1 note vs BOM sheets 2-3: screw rows are #4-40, #8-32, #10-32, 1/4-20; no #6-32. A note that names a size the package does not use is a stale carry-over (rule 24/25). #994 lists it as over-specification.

expectations.text: No over-specification finding asks the stacked-length band '137.574-137.974' (sheet 6 step 1) to lose decimal places: a dimension with its own explicit band is toleranced by that band.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 6 step 1 prints the stack acceptance as an explicit 0.400-wide band. Rule 3: a dimension carrying its own band is toleranced by it, never by its places.

expectations.text: A blocker reports that sheet 9 lists 'CONE-PLATFORM SWING' under 'FREE, NEVER LOCKED' while check 4 on the same sheet says 'LOOSEN MHA-VN-013 ... TIGHTEN MHA-VN-013', i.e. the swing is locked by the thumb screw.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 9: 'FREE, NEVER LOCKED: CRANK SPIN, CONE-PLATFORM SWING, PINION SWING, LIFT-ROD/CAM SPIN' versus check 4 loosening and re-tightening MHA-VN-013 (vn-cone-lock-knob) to swing the platform. Rule 25: a check against a note that cannot both be true. Prior reviewer fable-v2-2 flagged it.

expectations.text: A blocker reports that the sheet-8 CONE STATION TABLE 'FRONT TO BACK: STN 1 T120 ... STN 20 T006' runs opposite to the views: in the FRONT, TOP and RIGHT views the T120 (crank) end of the cone set is at the back, and nothing in the package reconciles the table's 'front' with the views' FRONT.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 8 station table header 'FRONT TO BACK'; sheet 1 FRONT 1:3 looks from the tip-block end (tip block in front of the cone spiral), so T120/crank lies at the top edge of TOP and the back of RIGHT; step 1 puts 'T120 SOUTH' by the MHA-DT-007 crank. Rule 25 names 'a station table ordered opposite to the views' as a blocker. Note: fr-top-frame sheet 1 carries an explicit note that machine front is the print's back; the dt package carries no such note. review-old Codex flagged the same.

expectations.text: No finding reports the BOM quantity 3 for MHA-VN-033 as disagreeing with the steps: step 11 uses 1 and step 16 uses 2 PL.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly BOM MHA-VN-033 QTY 3; sheet 7 step 11 (1X) + sheet 8 step 16 (2 PL) = 3.

expectations.text: No finding reports the 2.50 feeler set of step 18 as disagreeing with the 2.30-2.70 acceptance repeated in sheet 9 check 7.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly sheet 8 step 18 sets 2.50 with accept 2.30-2.70; sheet 9 check 7 cites step 18 with the same 2.50 / 2.30-2.70. The sheets agree (rule 25).

expectations.text: No blocker calls BOM items 15 (MHA-VN-015) and 31 (MHA-VN-020), both '#4-40 FILLISTER SCREW, MCMASTER 90280A108', a contradiction: two rows naming the same vendor part at different seats is duplication at most, not two numbers for one thing.
expectations.evidence: dt-drive-train-assembly BOM sheet 2/3 rows 15 and 31 share the McMaster number with different part numbers and seats (swing stop vs base screw per sheet 9). Rule 25 contradiction means a thing stated two incompatible ways; this is not.

evals.name: pivot-shaft-end-callout
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the ch-pivot-shaft part package.
evals.expected_output: FIX. '1.5 BOTH ENDS' contradicts 'PLAIN END UNCUT' and defines no end form; the stub left of the collar has no diameter.

expectations.text: Verdict is FIX
A blocker says '1.5 BOTH ENDS' contradicts the note 'SUPPLY 175 LONG, PLAIN END UNCUT' (rule 25)
A blocker says the '1.5' end callout defines no form (no angle, radius or chamfer designation)
A blocker says the short stub outboard of the Ø10 collar has no diameter
No over_specification finding objects to the note 'STOCK 10 BAR; CENTRES OK.'
expectations.evidence: MHA-CH-005 sheet 1, note line 1. Stock allowance and CENTRES OK are rule 7 allowed notes. Eval 2's blocker concerns line 2 ('PLAIN END UNCUT') versus '1.5 BOTH ENDS', not this line.

expectations.text: Reports that the Ø5.700 relief grooves in DETAIL A ('2.0 BOTH SHOULDER FACES') meet the Ø6.350 journal and the Ø10 collar at sharp internal corners with no fillet/corner radius given.
expectations.evidence: v40 ch-pivot-shaft sheet 1, DETAIL A: groove corners drawn sharp, no R callout; title-block R0.25 break applies to external edges only. Rule 11: shoulder fillets sized.

expectations.text: Does not flag the note 'STOCK 10 BAR; CENTRES OK.' as over-specification.
expectations.evidence: v40 ch-pivot-shaft sheet 1 note. Rule 11: state whether centres are allowed; the note does so.

expectations.text: No clarity finding reports the 'SOLIDWORKS Maker Product. For Personal Use Only.' watermark below the border as content outside the border
expectations.evidence: The watermark prints at bottom-left outside the inner border on every v40 sheet; it is licence boilerplate, not drawing content, and the reviewer prompt says never report it. A sloppy rule-13 reading would flag it.

expectations.text: No clarity finding says DETAIL A (SCALE 5:1) or the isometric breaks ASME alignment
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: DETAIL A is placed below the front view and the ISOMETRIC VIEW SCALE 1:2 at right; both are non-projected views, which rule 15 lets you move freely (alignment binds projected front/top/side views only).

expectations.text: Some finding says the internal corners where the Ø5.700 journals meet the Ø10.00 collar's shoulder faces (DETAIL A: '2.0 BOTH SHOULDER FACES', 'Ø5.700 BOTH SHOULDER FACES') carry no radius or maximum radius
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 DETAIL A SCALE 5:1: the steps from the Ø5.700 journal to the collar faces are drawn as sharp internal corners with no fillet or 'R MAX' note; the title-block edge break 'R0.25 OR CHAMFER 0.25 MAX' covers outside edges only. The shoulder faces locate the shaft against the ears, so the corner matters. Rule 16: no internal corner is perfectly sharp; state the largest acceptable radius when it matters.

evals.name: rocker-arm-hub-and-mate
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the ch-rocker-arm part package.
evals.expected_output: FIX. Worst-case hub wall is about 1.33 mm once the note-7 Ø0.50 coaxiality is counted; the Ø6.50 +0.03/0 reamed pivot bore names no mate.

expectations.text: Verdict is FIX
A blocker gives a worst-case hub wall of about 1.33 mm, counting the Ø0.50 coaxiality offset, below the 1.5 mm floor (rule 17)
A blocker says the Ø6.50 +0.03/0 pivot bore's tight band names no mating part or fit (rule 4)
Some finding says the Ø1.99 rod-pin hole callout gives no process (DRILL or REAM)
An over_specification finding flags the two-place profile sizes in note 3, 'TOP EDGE R800.00, BOTTOM EDGE R816.00' and '808.00 REF', as needing only one place
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 note 3: 'TOP EDGE R800.00, BOTTOM EDGE R816.00, CONCENTRIC; COMMON CENTRE ON THE MIRROR AXIS, 808.00 REF FROM THE PIVOT AXIS (STRAP DEPTH 16.00 REF).' Outside-profile arcs of a strap need no ±0.51 control (rule 3; rule 4: an outside profile gets the loosest band).

expectations.text: No blocker says the hub width '7.056 +0.05/0.00' lacks a mate or stack; note 7 says 'THE HUBS SET THE STATION PITCH (NO SPACERS)'
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: '7.056 +0.05 0.00' in the side view; note 7 '… CENTRED ON THE STRAP: THE HUBS SET THE STATION PITCH (NO SPACERS).' Rule 4: a width that sets a stack names the stack (at most clarity because it is not at the callout).

expectations.text: No over_specification finding calls the position frame '⌖ Ø0.20 | A | B | C' on the Ø1.99 rod-pin hole (basics 133.07 and 8.46) unneeded GD&T
expectations.evidence: MHA-CH-006 sheet 1: complete frame with datums A (Ø6.50 pivot bore), B (hub face) and C (arm-end edge) and boxed basics 133.07 and 8.46. The rocker is one of 20 repeated channel parts; rule 5 explicitly allows frames that keep a feature consistent across the repeated channel parts.

expectations.text: No over_specification finding objects to the Ra 1.6 symbol on the Ø6.50 +0.03/0 pivot bore
expectations.evidence: MHA-CH-006 sheet 1: Ra 1.6 leader to the Ø6.50 +0.03/0 bore (datum A), the bore the rocker pivots on MHA-CH-005. A running/rocking bore takes Ra 1.6.

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags note 7's 'HUB OD COAXIAL WITH PIVOT BORE WITHIN Ø0.50 (TURN HUB AND REAM BORE IN ONE SETUP)' as a tolerance in a note and/or a method (rule 7)
expectations.evidence: MHA-CH-006 sheet 1 note 7, verbatim. The block has 7 numbered notes; note 4 'ARC LENGTHS 292.10 TOP / 266.70 BOTTOM' also carries dimensions.

expectations.text: Reports that there is no conspicuous overall length dimension on the views; the outline is defined only through notes 3-5 (R800.00/R816.00 radii, 808.00 REF, arc lengths 292.10/266.70, 5.59 land).
expectations.evidence: v40 ch-rocker-arm sheet 1: no dimension spans the full arc length on any view; overall extent must be derived from note arc lengths. Rule 10: every part gets a conspicuous overall.

expectations.text: Reports that the pivot bore callout 'Ø6.50 +0.03/0.00' gives no process at the callout; REAM appears only in remote note '6. PIVOT HOLE: REAM.'
expectations.evidence: v40 ch-rocker-arm sheet 1: bore callout without process; note 6 supplies it. Rule 12 (and rule 7: notes do not carry what belongs at the feature).

expectations.text: No blocker says the hub width band 7.056 +0.05/0 names no stack: note 7 'THE HUBS SET THE STATION PITCH (NO SPACERS)' names the stack the band serves.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: hub width '7.056 +0.05/0' and note 7 'THE HUBS SET THE STATION PITCH (NO SPACERS)'; ch-channel-assembly step 1 measures the 20-hub stack and re-faces a long one. The band names its function (rule 4) and the stack is absorbed at fit-up (rule 19).

evals.name: cone-pivot-post-boss-and-frame
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the dt-cone-pivot-post part package.
evals.expected_output: FIX. The Ø17.2 cone journal boss faces sit 42.01 apart on a Ø42.0 body and nearly vanish; the crank-bore angularity frame cannot be set up from the shown datums/basic.

expectations.text: Verdict is FIX
A blocker says the Ø17.2 cone journal boss faces (42.01 apart on the Ø42.0 body) vanish or cannot exist within tolerance
A blocker says the crank-bore geometric control (angularity/perpendicularity to A and B with the 12.52° basic) contradicts the views or cannot be set up
No blocker says the Finish field is missing masking or protection: 'RAL 6005 ALKYD; SSPC-SP 3; 50-75 um DFT; MASK MACHINED FACES; OIL BARE FACES ISO VG 32' is complete

expectations.text: No blocker says the crank bore 'Ø11.438 +0.005/-0.025' or the cone bore 'Ø12.281 +0.005/-0.025' lacks a mate; the sheet note 'CRANK BORE CARRIES MHA-DT-011, CONE BORE MHA-DT-004' names them (at most clarity)
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 notes: 'CRANK BORE CARRIES MHA-DT-011, CONE BORE MHA-DT-004; FOOT ON MHA-DT-020.' Reviewer prompt: a mate named in the package but not at the tight callout is clarity, not a blocker.

expectations.text: No over_specification finding objects to the Ra 3.2 symbol on the post foot (its static locating seat)
expectations.evidence: MHA-DT-005 sheet 1: Ra 3.2 on the foot (datum B), the face the post is screwed down on ('DRILL MOUNTING HOLES FROM TOP FACE'); Ra 1.6 on the crank and cone bores. Rule 6 allows 'one static mating seat that locates the part on its neighbour (a foot on a base)' at Ra 3.2.

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the note 'DRILL MOUNTING HOLES FROM TOP FACE; CHECK CONE BORE AT BREAKOUT.' as a method note (rule 7)
expectations.evidence: MHA-DT-005 sheet 1 note block, verbatim. The note prescribes drilling direction and an in-process check, which are methods, not dimensioned geometry.

expectations.text: Reports that 'Ø11.438 +0.005/-0.025 CRANK BORE THRU' and 'Ø12.281 +0.005/-0.025 CONE BORE THRU RIMS BREAK 0.1 MAX' give no process (DRILL/REAM/BORE).
expectations.evidence: v40 dt-cone-pivot-post sheet 1: both bore callouts carry size, tolerance and THRU but no process word. Rule 12.

expectations.text: A minor finding says the wall between the 2X Ø11.51 ↧6.02 counterbores (12.98 off axis) and the Ø42.8 head OD is about 2.67 nominal and about 1.5 at the worst case of the title-block bands

A finding reports that the Ø42.8 HEAD over the Ø42.0 body is a 0.4 mm radial step that vanishes or reverses inside the one-place ±0.8 general tolerance, and that the '21.38 CRANK BOSS FACE' sits inside the Ø42.8 head radius (21.4), so the drawn head/boss geometry controls nothing as modelled.

evals.name: frame-assembly-engagement-not-blocking
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the fr-frame assembly package (3 sheets).
evals.expected_output: Unverifiable thread engagement is recorded in minor, never as a blocker.

expectations.text: No blocker is about thread engagement depth being unverifiable
A minor finding says full-thread engagement is not verifiable from the package

The title block's standard rows (general tolerances, DRILLED HOLES +0.10/0, edge break, CAST/MACHINED, thread class) on the assembly sheets are not flagged as over-specification or as calling for reinspection of supplied parts
expectations.evidence: Sheets 1-2 carry the standard title block with Finish/Material 'SEE COMPONENT DRAWINGS'. Rule 2: these rows are the shared sheet format; on an assembly they govern work done at assembly.

expectations.text: No blocker says the column-to-socket match fit lacks acceptance; sheet 3 states 'CLOSE HAND-SLIP, NO PERCEPTIBLE ROCK, FULL SHOULDER SEATING' for each socket's assigned tube
expectations.evidence: Sheet 3 match-fit sequence step 1: '… FIT EACH MHA-FR-001 SOCKET TO ITS ASSIGNED ACTUAL TUBE: CLOSE HAND-SLIP, NO PERCEPTIBLE ROCK, FULL SHOULDER SEATING. RETAIN COLUMN/CORNER/ORIENTATION MATCH MARKS.' Rule 4: a matched pair names the mate and an unambiguous functional acceptance.

expectations.text: Reports that SECTION B-B (sheet 1, SCALE 1:3) carries dashed hidden lines (a dashed circle around the upper-left corner socket/column and dashed rectangles and a dashed circle around the left-rail clamp hub/set-screw) among the hatched cut faces.

Rule 9: 'A section never carries hidden lines'; hatched slices among dashed ghosts is the named failure.

expectations.text: No clarity finding says sheet 2 should be landscape: portrait is right for a BOM above the tall 1:8 exploded frame
expectations.evidence: Sheet 2 is portrait: full-width BOM (items 1-10) at top, tall exploded view 1:8 below. Rule 15: choose orientation by the useful scale of the views and room for the BOM.

expectations.text: No blocker says the column height stack lacks an adjustment: step 4 'FINAL MATCH-CUT EACH IDENTIFIED COLUMN TO THE ACTUAL BASE/TOP/CAP STACK' and steps 2/5 pilot-transfer and enlarge the tube cross holes to Ø5.00 from the actual casting bores.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 3 steps 1-5 as quoted; the frame height stack is absorbed by match-cutting the columns and transfer-drilling, rule 19's named fit-up.

expectations.text: No blocker reports a missing parts list, balloon, exploded view or step: the 10-row BOM is fully ballooned on sheet 2's exploded view and sheet 3 carries steps 1-10 and checks 1-5.

evals.name: sh-column-clamp-front-rules
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the sh-column-clamp-front part package.
evals.expected_output: Rule-coverage case (rules 2, 3, 5, 7): reports each negative finding in the stated category and raises no positive-case item.

expectations.evidence: Title block Finish: 'black enamel; bore, bar face + ear holes masked'; Material 'LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON'. Masked ferrous surfaces are left bare with no oil or other protection (rule 2).

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the notes 'GRAY IRON CASTING; MACHINE ALL SURFACES SHOWN' and 'PAINT BLACK AFTER MACHINING; BORE, BAR FACE AND EAR HOLES MASKED' for restating material and finish outside the title block
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 notes repeat the finish ('PAINT BLACK AFTER MACHINING; BORE, BAR FACE AND EAR HOLES MASKED' vs Finish 'black enamel; bore, bar face + ear holes masked') and narrow the material ('GRAY IRON CASTING' vs Material 'LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON'). expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the two-place block sizes '48.00', '17.90' and '16.00' on the clamp block as needing only one place
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: outline sizes 48.00, 17.90 and 16.00 are printed at two places (±0.51) on a cast block whose only fits are the Ø25.6 slip bore and the ear holes. Rule 3: noncritical overall sizes generally need one place.

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the parallelism frame '// 0.10 | A' on the 16.00-thick clamp bar face (rule 5)
expectations.evidence: MHA-SH-001 sheet 1, lower-left view: //|0.10|A on the bar face of the 16.00 dimension, datum A on the side face. A split column clamp's faces are clamp faces; rule 5: 'flatness on a clamp face ... is over-specification'.

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the notes 'GRAY IRON CASTING; MACHINE ALL SURFACES SHOWN.' and/or 'PAINT BLACK AFTER MACHINING; BORE, BAR FACE AND EAR HOLES MASKED.' as material/finish repeated outside the title block or as method (rule 7)
expectations.evidence: MHA-SH-001 sheet 1 note block, 7 lines. The Material field reads 'LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON' and the Finish field 'black enamel; bore, bar face + ear holes masked', so both notes repeat the title block. 'MACHINE ALL SURFACES SHOWN' is a method.

evals.name: sm-knife-mount-rules
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the sm-knife-mount part package.
evals.expected_output: Rule-coverage case (rules 2, 5, 7, 9, 10, 12, 14): reports each negative finding in the stated category and raises no positive-case item.

expectations.text: Some finding reports that 'HARDEN AND TEMPER TO 58-60 HRC' needs a hardenable steel grade, but the Material field names only the generic 'Plain Carbon Steel'
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 note: 'HARDEN AND TEMPER TO 58-60 HRC AFTER MACHINING; LEAVE UNPAINTED. THE BORE UPPER WALL IS THE HARDENED KNIFE SEAT.' Material: 'Plain Carbon Steel'. Rule 2: a specific grade is required where function needs it; low-carbon steel cannot reach 58-60 HRC, so the builder must ask which steel.

expectations.text: A blocker says the position frame '⌖ Ø0.20 | A' on the Ø12.00 THRU knife-seat bore has no basic dimension locating the bore (its 20.37 location appears only in the note) and no datum for its centring in the 24.00 width (rule 5)
expectations.evidence: MHA-SM-002 sheet 1 front view: ⌖|Ø0.20|A leadered to the Ø12.00 THRU bore; datum A on the top seat. The views carry only 24.00, 29.37 (block height) and 14.00, none boxed; the note says 'CENTRE 20.37 BELOW THE TOP SEAT (DATUM A)' and 'CENTRED IN THE 24.00 WIDTH'. Rule 5: 'a located feature with no basic is a defect'; the part prompt puts a geometric control missing datums or basics in blockers.

expectations.text: An over_specification finding flags the knife-mount note block for repeating the finish ('LEAVE UNPAINTED') outside the title block, carrying the bore location ('CENTRE 20.37 BELOW THE TOP SEAT (DATUM A)') as a note, or running well past four lines (rule 7)
expectations.evidence: MHA-SM-002 sheet 1: a 10-line note block. The Finish field reads 'heat treated, unpainted' while the note repeats 'LEAVE UNPAINTED', and the note carries the location 'CENTRE 20.37 BELOW THE TOP SEAT (DATUM A)'. 'THE BORE IS THE KNIFE-EDGE BEARING' is an allowed functional reason under rule 7 and is not the defect.

expectations.text: Reports that the 1/2-13 tapped hole's depth and its tap-drill breakthrough into the Ø12.00 bore are shown only by hidden (dashed) lines in the front and side views, with no section cut, so the internal shape is read from hidden lines.
expectations.evidence: v40 sm-knife-mount sheet 1: the 1/2-13 tapped hole drops from the top seat toward the Ø12.00 knife bore crown. In both orthographic views it appears only as dashed lines; no section view exists; the callout reads only '1/2-13 Tapped Hole' and the depth 'X 12.0 DEEP' is in the note. Rule 9: internal shape that matters needs a section, not hidden lines.

expectations.text: Reports as a blocker that the Ø12.00 knife bore has no location dimension on the views; its position is given only by the note 'CENTRED IN THE 24.00 WIDTH (ON THE BLOCK VERTICAL CENTRELINE), CENTRE 20.37 BELOW THE TOP SEAT', i.e. from a symmetry axis.
expectations.evidence: v40 sm-knife-mount sheet 1: no dimension locates the bore circle on any view; the note locates it from the block vertical centreline. Rule 10: a symmetry axis with no feature there is mid-air, and a note naming the origin does not cure it; the reviewer prompt lists a mid-air location origin as a blocker.

expectations.text: Reports that the '1/2-13 Tapped Hole' callout is a CAD default with no full-thread depth and no tap-drill size/depth for a blind tap; the depth 'X 12.0 DEEP' appears only in a note.
expectations.evidence: v40 sm-knife-mount sheet 1: leader text '1/2-13 Tapped Hole' only. Rule 12: a blind tap gives full-thread depth and a deeper tap-drill depth.

expectations.text: Reports that the 'Ø12.00 THRU' knife-edge bearing bore (Ra 0.8) gives no process (REAM/BORE).
expectations.evidence: v40 sm-knife-mount sheet 1: callout 'Ø12.00 THRU' without process on a fine-finish bearing bore. Rule 12: hole callout gives decimal Ø and process.

expectations.text: A clarity finding says the '29.37' dimension line runs through the 'Ø12.00 THRU' callout text
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 front view: the vertical 29.37 dimension line passes between 'Ø' and '12.00' of the 'Ø12.00 THRU' callout, and the callout leader crosses that dimension line (cf. #1000). Rule 14: no text on a line, no leader across a dimension line.

expectations.evidence: sm-summing-assembly sheet 1 (only sheet): three views plus isometric, no BOM, no balloons. Rule 22. #1297 Codex blind review found the same.

expectations.evidence: sm-summing-assembly sheet 1: assembled views only; no exploded view, no steps.

evals.name: sm-summing-lever-rules
evals.prompt: Blind machinist review of the sm-summing-lever part package.

expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: the curved arms between the Ø19.05 anchor boss and the 152.40 pivot carry no radius or location dimensions; note 5 reads 'CAST PART: UNDIMENSIONED CONTOURS PER SUPPLIED MODEL/PATTERN. MACHINE KNIFE EDGES AND TAP SPRING ANCHOR SEATS ONLY.' No pattern or model is part of the drawing package.

expectations.text: The note 'PIVOT 152.40 LONG; NO BORE', which repeats the 152.40 dimension on the view, is not reported as a blocker (a redundant correct dimension is not a defect)
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: dimension '152.40' on the view and note 3 'PIVOT 152.40 LONG; NO BORE.' agree. Rule 1: 'A redundant correct dimension never hurt anyone.' At most a rule-7 note-count over_specification.

expectations.text: A blocker reports that the Finish field 'green enamel; knife edges machined, spring-anchor seats tapped' states no masking of the machined knife edges/tapped seats and no protection of those bare surfaces
expectations.evidence: Title block Finish: 'green enamel; knife edges machined, spring-anchor seats tapped'; Material 'LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON'. The Ra 1.6 knife edges are machined bright on a painted ferrous part; neither a mask nor bare-surface protection is in the Finish field (rule 2).

expectations.text: No over_specification finding calls the 20X position frame '⌖ Ø0.30 | A | B' on the 6-32 UNC spring-anchor taps unneeded GD&T
expectations.evidence: MHA-SM-003 sheet 1: 20X Ø2.71 THRU ALL 6-32 UNC-2B with ⌖|Ø0.30|A|B. The 20 anchors match the 20 channel springs and the lever carries the knife edges; rule 5 allows 'the knife-edge system' and 'a pattern ... that must match its mate'.

expectations.text: Some finding questions the '20X Ø2.71 THRU ALL / 6-32 UNC-2B THRU ALL' taps in the LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON lever (#6-32 in tough material)
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: 20 #6-32 taps through the 5.08 coefficient plate; title-block material LOW-CARBON STEEL OR GRAY IRON. Rule 16: avoid #6-32 and smaller taps in tough material.

expectations.text: A blocker reports that the '20X Ø2.71 THRU ALL / 6-32 UNC-2B THRU ALL' eyebolt taps in the 'COEFFICIENT PLATE 5.08 THICK' (note 2) give under 1.5D engagement (5.08/3.505 = 1.45D nominal, less after the 0.25 edge breaks), since note 6 says 'SPRING EYEBOLTS THREAD DIRECTLY INTO THIS PART' and no shortfall is stated.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1: hole callout '20X Ø2.71 THRU ALL / 6-32 UNC-2B THRU ALL'; note 2 'COEFFICIENT PLATE 5.08 THICK'; note 6 'SPRING EYEBOLTS THREAD DIRECTLY INTO THIS PART'. 5.08 mm / 3.505 mm major = 1.45D before edge breaks. No 'ENGAGEMENT ... MIN' statement. Unstated rule 18 shortfall → blocker (Codex also flagged this in issue #1295).

expectations.text: The 6-32 eyebolt-tap engagement in the 5.08 plate is reported as a blocker, not a minor, because no shortfall is stated on the sheet.
expectations.evidence: Sheet 1 notes 2 and 6 and the 6-32 callout as quoted; no engagement statement. Unstated → blocker per rule 20 and the appendix.
